scope: One bounded AB/C repair: frozen prior temporal encoders + newly trained shared relation query head; fixed relation library and unchanged learned rules; aligned generic effect monitor.

data.old_D_observations_used: No D data enter training or model selection; prior D diagnostics motivated audit and monitor correction.
data.hard_examples: 54 existing causal windows: ordinary/support-contact negatives and held positives, re-encode with current RGB-only regions; all7 physical labels separately valid-masked.
data.rules: 132 AB transitions from36roots;42 C transitions from12roots; successful effects plus real failed/refused tuples for preconditions; never invent success effects for failures.

architecture: Frozen prior object/context encoders + object/scene GRUs. Old classification heads discarded. New predicate embedding + shared edge MLP400→128→64→1 trained from scratch; typed drawer/gripper anchors share global public scene context. No GT or colour ID input.
history: 4 causal public frames at[-63,-42,-21,0],2.1s, no previous predicates/actions or occlusion memory module

training.sampling: uniform AB roots, uniform window within root; all7 queries perwindow; record indices
training.loss: mean across Holding/In/Open groups of valid binary cross entropy with AB-only inverse class weights
training.selection: minimum C root-macro group-balanced BCE, tie earlier; all1200 updates always run; no D selection; fixed threshold.5
training.pretraining: Old frozen encoder checkpoint SHA9fbfc0992073acc942802339f1fb82c30e2cf44bb7ef90e9c514dd423b5365d3 from larger previous AB corpus; C selected before current D. Classification heads unused. Not a matched-pretraining comparison.

rules.positive_effects: exact before/after differences, normalized by action argument roles, cluster by skill and lifted add/delete sets
rules.derived: EmptyHand is forall blocks notHolding; OtherHeld exists non-target held. Definitions are supplied; inclusion in learned preconditions is learned.
rules.learner: intersect positive pre-state literals; enumerate shortest conjunction excluding real same-skill failures and other effect clusters; accuracy minus0.001*literal_count explicit; if no exact separator preserve conflict and mark unsupported
rules.target_binding: Lift explicit colour argument; Place binds x to unique currently held object (motor-skill convention), empty-grip negative has no bound x. No invented unexecuted object-action negatives.

test.goals: closed-initial roots: In(target,drawer) and closed; open-initial roots: In(target,drawer) and In(nextcolour,drawer) and closed
test.planner: BFS depth8, expansion512, learned preconditions/effects only; re-read real endpoint and replan eachstep; stop on UNKNOWN, no plan, refused controller or native failure without visually confirmed learned effects, repeated symbolic state-action, or budget.
test.controller: unchanged PhysicalOracle900 primitive controls+96 realhold each call; initial96hold; no intermediate resets or forced successes
test.extra_state_diagnostics: after each executed macro, at most2 preregistered past windows: first closed-gripper descend anchor and lower_into_drawer firstframe+63 if available, only for perception scoring, never planning. No model adaptation.
test.freezing: new root layouts and model/rule hashes frozen before any test physics; exclude all archived roots by ID/seed/layout; retain failures, no replacement
test.comparison: GT symbols diagnostic uses same learned rules and controller. Fixed symbolic rules scored offline on same7facts. Old reader only a frozen perception baseline on same images.
test.acceptance: report per-predicate positive/negative/UNKNOWN, full7 and roots; applicability vs real status, success-effect prediction; real task success including every assigned root. Running version is functional evidence, not reliability certification or original guide completion.
test.monitor: After native failed status, retain failure flag, confirm learned add/delete literals with same current input state source; if all confirmed replan, otherwise stop. No native success relabeling.

prior_test_seen: v1 six roots and v2 three targeted roots; no gradient, checkpoint selection or threshold selection uses these test observations. C repair rationale recorded before new training.
